description: Compare monthly and annual cost of AI coding subscriptions (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code/Pro/Max, OpenAI Codex) for a given team size and usage intensity, then compare the winner against pay-as-you-go API pricing for the same workload. Prices verified 2026-09.

apiModel.description: Model id for the API baseline (default claude-4-sonnet)

includeApiBaseline.description: Also compute the pay-as-you-go API cost for the same workload (default true)

usageLevel.description: Usage intensity: light, standard, heavy or extreme (default standard)

name: compare_ai_coding_tool_costs
